verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a VPN and network-connectivity platform. Searching and navigating code content with fuzzy matching, filters, and regex belongs to code hosts and editors, so this story is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Tailscale shipping a code-search capability. Mentions of SSH, remote coding environments, and a coding-agent skill concern connectivity or integration, not code search.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and navigate code content using fuzzy matching, filters, and regular expressions
